r0.title: Can I give up the Bonus Dollars promotion at any time?
r0.desc:
You may choose to give up the Bonus Dollars promotion only when your Bonus Wallet balance is below the equivalent of {{amount}}USDT during its validity period.
Please note that once you give up, your remaining Bonus Wallet balance will be cleared and cannot be restored or withdrawn.
As there can only be one Bonus Wallet promotion active at any one time, you will be eligible to participate and purchase other Bonus Wallet promotions after you give up on your current Bonus Wallet promotion.

r1.title: What is the Bonus Dollar?
r1.desc: Bonus Dollars are a special play credit you can use just like real money on selected games. Bonus Dollars convert into withdraw-able cash once you complete the play-through requirement.

r2.title: What are the minimum and maximum claim amounts?
r2.desc: You can claim your bonus once you’ve reached at least <0>{{min}}</0> in eligible bonus winnings, up to a maximum of <0>{{max}}</0>.

r3.title: Can I continue playing even after reaching the claim limit?
r3.desc: Yes, you can keep playing with your bonus balance for fun - but your claim will still be limited to the maximum of <0>{{max}}<0/>.

r4.title: Which games can I play using my bonus balance?
r4.desc: You can use your bonus on selected participating games. Look for the Bonus Tag or check the Game List for details.

r5.title: Can I withdraw my bonus money immediately?
r5.desc: Not yet - you’ll need to complete the wagering requirement first. Once done, you can claim your eligible amount, which will be transferred to your main balance for withdrawal or continued play.

r6.title: What happens to my bonus balance after I claim it?
r6.desc: Once you claim your bonus, your bonus wallet will be reset to zero, and your claimed amount will move to your main account balance. You can then withdraw or keep playing as you like.

r7.title: How are my rewards calculated and credited?
r7.desc: All rewards are calculated and credited in <0>{{currency}}/USDT</0>, then displayed in your preferred fiat currency for convenience. Please note that currency conversions are approximate and may vary slightly depending on the exchange rate at the time.

r8.title: Are there any rules or restrictions I should know about?
r8.desc: Yes. The casino reserves the right to modify, suspend, or revoke eligibility for this event at any time without prior notice. Any abuse, multiple account usage, or fraudulent activity will result in immediate disqualification from the promotion.

r9.title: What are the minimum and maximum claim amounts?
r9.desc: You can cash out your bonus once you’ve fulfilled the wagering conditions.

r10.title: Can I continue playing even after reaching the cashout limit?
r10.desc: Yes, you can keep playing with your bonus balance for fun - but your claim will still be limited to the cashout limit.

r11.title: When will the bonus dollars expire / Can I give up on the promotion?
r11.desc:
Bonus dollars expire 30 days after they are issued, so you have 30 days to complete the turnover requirement. You can also choose to give up the Bonus Dollars Promotion at any time. 
 When you give up on the promotion, your current Bonus Dollars balance will be cleared and no refund will be given. You will be able to participate in future Bonus Dollars Promotions. 
 There can be only 1 Bonus Dollars Promotion active at any one time.
